key_insight: Physics-informed graph-based safe reinforcement learning coordinates community batteries to reduce distribution-network violations while maintaining competitive operating cost.
engineering_relevance: The approach supports safer operation of distribution networks with high rooftop solar penetration and variable EV charging; it does not address solar-cell materials discovery.
method: Encode network interactions using a dual-level graph shaped by line impedance and capacity.
Regularize latent states with power-balance, voltage-profile, and flow-reconstruction losses.
Use Lagrangian Dedicated-Critic PPO with separate reward and constraint critics, combining advantages during policy updates.
evidence_signal: Distribution-network case studies report up to 80.5% lower voltage-violation degree than tested baselines, alongside the lowest voltage-violation count and line-overload degree with competitive operating cost.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish hard safety guarantees or validation in real-world grid deployments.
paper_title: Physics-Informed Graph-Based Safe RL with Constraint-Specific Critics for Community Battery Coordination in Distribution Network
